title: 'Operation TAP' : Netflix’s First Film in Portugal Is Already in Production
summary: Rui Pedro Silva, Afonso Pimentel and Victoria Guerra star in this film directed by João Nuno Pinto.
body_markdown:
Entertainment


03 November 2026


Global


Portugal


Link copied to clipboard

Netflix has today announced the start of production on


Operation TAP


, Netflix’s first film in Portugal, directed by


João Nuno Pinto


(


Mosquito, 18 Holes to Paradise


).


The film, starring


Rui Pedro Silva


(


Remains of the Wind, Maria Vitória


),


Afonso Pimentel


(


Memories of Prison, Turn of the Tide


), and


Victoria Guerra


(


Impossible Lovel, Gloria


), is loosely based on the true story of the hijacking of a TAP flight in 1980, carried out by a 16-year-old boy with a head full of dreams. An adventure with an ’80s vibe and a modern pace that combines tension and emotion to tell how a night of fear ultimately turned into something no one expected.


Operation TAP


is produced by


SPi


, part of the SP Televisão Group and the production company behind


Glória


, Netflix’s first Portuguese series, and is written by


Pedro Lopes


,


Miguel Rico


, and


Marina Preguiça Ribeiro


.


Synopsis:


1980. An armed teenager hijacks a plane to Madrid and demands $10 million, turning the passengers and crew into hostages for a night of tension and uncertainty. But what begins as a threat of violence ultimately reveals an unexpected story of empathy and humanity between the young hijacker and those he holds hostage.


About SPi


:


SPi, an international brand of the SP Televisão Group, specializes in developing original content for international markets and in international co-productions. A pioneer in producing content for major streaming platforms, its portfolio includes acclaimed series such as


Glória


,


Codex 632


,


Vanda


, and


Cold Haven


. With more than 30 international awards and nominations, SPi has established itself as a leader in Portuguese audiovisual production, combining creative ambition with a strong international focus and a growing network of international partnerships.
